scene_evidence.observation: An outline map of India is shown with East and West directional arrows asking whether the Tapi river flows East or West without revealing the answer.
Two options ('पूर्व, बंगाल की खाड़ी की ओर' and 'पश्चिम, अरब सागर की ओर') are presented with a pause to allow thinking time.
The correct answer 'पश्चिम, अरब सागर की ओर' is revealed alongside map markers for Multai and Khambhat.
The origin point at Multai in Madhya Pradesh is highlighted on the map as the narration explains its source.
The river's westward path towards the Gulf of Khambhat and Arabian Sea is demonstrated on the map.
A clear revision card displays the summary takeaway 'याद रखें: पश्चिम, अरब सागर की ओर'.
